Class DiaryEntryRegister

java.lang.Object
DiaryEntryRegister
public class DiaryEntryRegister extends Object
Manages a collection of DiaryEntry objects and provides functionality for creating, storing, and serializing diary entries to a JSON file

The register uses a Gson instance configured with a custom DiaryEntryTypeAdapter, which allowes LocalDateTime fields inside DiaryEntry objects to be correctly serialised and deserialised.

      public ArrayList<DiaryEntry> getDiaryEntriesList()
      Returns the internal list of the diary entries.

      This method is private because the method is not intended to be exposed externally.

      Returns:
      a list containing all diary entries

    • searchByKeyword

      public ArrayList<DiaryEntry> searchByKeyword(String keyword)
      Searches for diary entries containing the specified keyword.

      The search is case-insensitive and checks the title, content, author name, and date (formatted as dd.MM.yyyy).

      Parameters:
      keyword - the word or phrase to search for
      Returns:
      a list of diary entries that contain the keyword
